story: My company signed us up for a CSR afternoon and I almost didn't go. Two hours in, I was arguing with a ten-year-old about whether bocce rules allow a second throw. I've since signed up on my own three more times — nobody told me it would be this fun.

Every other programme we tried started with a list of what my son couldn't do. Love 21 started with which session he wanted to try first. Eighteen months later he corrects the coaches on the floor curling rules. I don't think I'll ever get used to how normal that feels, in the best way.
以前帶女兒去邊度都要解釋一次佢嘅情況，好似要事先攞人哋原諒。喺 Love 21，冇人叫我解釋，佢哋直接問我女幾時得閒返嚟。呢種被當成「一般家庭」對待嘅感覺，我等咗好耐。

I set up a monthly donation two years ago mostly out of guilt about not having time to volunteer. Reading the impact report this year and seeing the per-session breakdown made me realise the guilt was misplaced — the money is doing exactly what I hoped, just without me standing in the room.

Growing up, most of my sister's activities were things I could only watch from the side. At Love 21 I started as her plus-one at family sessions and now I help run warm-ups. It's the first programme where the whole family gets to actually do something, not just wait in a corridor.
第一次做義工嗰陣其實幾驚，怕唔識點同小朋友相處。教練喺開始前同我哋講咗十分鐘，之後全程都喺埋身指導。落堂嗰刻先發現自己笑到面都僵埋。想講返俾其他考慮做義工嘅人知，真係唔需要有經驗先可以幫到手。

I bought a table at the Beyond Limits Banquet last year almost as a work obligation. I ended up staying two hours past when I could have left because the families at my table kept telling me things the speeches hadn't mentioned. Booking again this year, and bringing my own guests this time instead of being someone else's plus-one.

Amazing session today! Shoutout to little Chloe Wong from Diocesan Girls' Junior School, room 4B — her mum said she's been talking about it non-stop and mentioned she's doing really well since her surgery in March. Can't wait to come back!
